      21                 :             : /// \brief Class that should be inherited by moveable class T to allow it to hand out references to itself while
      22                 :             : /// allowing these references to be updated when the moveable class T is moved.
      23                 :             : //
      24                 :             : /// See the test file for this class for an example of how to use this class.
      25                 :             : ///
      26                 :             : /// Reason for this class: In various places in our codebase, we have the issue in which we hand out a reference to a
      27                 :             : /// class which is moveable. If the class is moved, then we need to update this reference. E.g. SkeletonBase stores a
      28                 :             : /// map of references to its service elements. Each service element therefore must store a reference to the SkeletonBase
      29                 :             : /// and update the reference to itself when it's moved. The SkeletonBase must also update the reference to itself within
      30                 :             : /// each service element when it is moved.
      31                 :             : ///
      32                 :             : /// To avoid such complexity, this commit introduces a class EnableReferenceToMoveableFromThis which will be inherited
      33                 :             : /// by each service element. This stores a ReferenceToMoveable which is stored on the heap so a reference to it will
      34                 :             : /// never be invalidated. The ReferenceToMoveable will be updated when the service element is moved. A
      35                 :             : /// ReferenceToMoveable::Reference is provided to SkeletonBase from which it can get a reference to the service element,
      36                 :             : /// even if it's been moved. With this approach, the service element doesn't need to store a reference to the parent
      37                 :             : /// SkeletonBase so the parent SkeletonBase doesn't need to inform the service element when it moves.
      38                 :             : ///
      39                 :             : /// NOTE: This class is not thread safe. It is the responsibility of the user to ensure that the reference is not
      40                 :             : /// accessed while the moveable class (and therefore this class) is being moved. In our current architecture, this is
      41                 :             : /// not an issue as we only allow single threaded access to Skeleton / Proxy objects and their service elements, so we
      42                 :             : /// will never be accessing the references while a Skeleton or Proxy object is being moved.
